name: public-mcp-gate-receipt

# job polling for up to an hour per pull request push: that poll held a Windows
# runner for as long as the Linux checks queued (clued-ci-company-win-01 on
# 2026-09-29). Each run reads the candidate's check runs once and reports the
# verdict as the `public-mcp-gate-receipt` commit status on the candidate. It is

# gate on the same paths as before. A terminal verdict is also written as the
# completed check run `public-mcp-gate-receipt-verdict`, because commit statuses
# raise no check-suite events for pull request watchers. The job runs the default
# branch's gate code and never checks out the pull request.
on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: [public-mcp-protocol, public-mcp-behavior, gitleaks, trivy]
    types: [completed]

permissions:
  actions: read
  checks: write
  contents: read
  statuses: write

# Serialize evaluations of one candidate so an earlier snapshot never posts
# after a later one; a newer pending evaluation supersedes an older pending one.
concurrency:
  group: public-mcp-gate-receipt-${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  trusted-self-hosted:
    name: public-mcp-gate-receipt-evaluate

      github.event.workflow_run.event == 'pull_request' &&
      github.event.workflow_run.head_repository.full_name == github.repository &&
      github.event.workflow_run.actor.login == github.repository_owner

        uses: ./trusted-gate/.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage
      - name: Verify pre-provisioned Node.js 24

          node --version

      github.event.workflow_run.event == 'pull_request' &&
      (github.event.workflow_run.head_repository.full_name != github.repository ||
       github.event.workflow_run.actor.login != github.repository_owner)

        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683

        uses: ./trusted-gate/.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage

          CANDIDATE_SHA: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
          GATE_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          GATE_PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.pull_requests[0].number }}

          GATE_RECEIPT_OUTPUT: ${{ runner.temp }}/public-mcp-gate-receipt.json
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: node trusted-gate/apps/clued-cloud/evals/public-mcp/gate-receipt.mjs
      - name: Report immutable receipt digest without writing an Artifact
        run: |
          receipt="${{ runner.temp }}/public-mcp-gate-receipt.json"
          if [ ! -f "$receipt" ]; then echo 'No receipt: required checks still running or gate not applicable.'; exit 0; fi
          (cd "$(dirname "$receipt")" && sha256sum public-mcp-gate-receipt.json)

name: memory-publication-gate

on:
  pull_request_target:
    paths:
      - memory/**
      - artifacts/clued-two-level-snapshots/**
      - scripts/verify-memory-publication.mjs
      - .github/workflows/memory-publication-gate.yml

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: memory-publication-gate-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  trusted-self-hosted:
    name: memory-publication-gate
    # Re-review 7, m1: pull_request_target runs for a pull request into any
    # branch, and that branch is the Agent's to edit; only pull requests into
    # the default branch run on the self-hosted runner, and both jobs take the
    # verifier from the default branch as it is now.
    if: >-
      github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
      github.actor == github.repository_owner &&
      github.event.pull_request.base.ref == github.event.repository.default_branch
    runs-on: [self-hosted, Windows, X64, clued, pool-general, trust-internal, cap-node24]
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Check out trusted verifier from the default branch
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}
          path: trusted
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Check out candidate without persisted credentials
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          path: candidate
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
      - name: Configure job temporary storage
        uses: ./trusted/.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage
      - name: Verify pre-provisioned Node.js 24
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          node --version
          node -e "const [m]=process.versions.node.split('.').map(Number); if (m !== 24) process.exit(1)"
      - name: Reject direct memory edits outside an atomic snapshot publication
        shell: powershell
        run: >-
          node trusted/scripts/verify-memory-publication.mjs
          --repo candidate
          --base ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          --candidate ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}

  untrusted-hosted:
    name: memory-publication-gate
    if: >-
      github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name != github.repository ||
      github.actor != github.repository_owner ||
      github.event.pull_request.base.ref != github.event.repository.default_branch

    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:

        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}
          path: trusted
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Check out candidate without persisted credentials

          fetch-depth: 0
          path: candidate
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Configure job temporary storage

name: kooyumi-work-admission

# Work Claim Admission v0.1 §4.6 L0a (development/contracts/execution-admission/
# WorkClaimAdmission.v0.1.md). An unfiltered check on every pull request, a
# `main` ruleset required check like gitleaks and trivy. It makes one Clued
# call per run: clued_work_verify_v1 on the Clued database's PostgREST endpoint
# (public publishable key, SHA-256 of the read-only Binding token in the
# environment secret CLUED_ADMISSION_CLUED_TOKEN), asking whether the claim
# named in the PR body or head commit (`Clued-Work-Claim: <id>`) admits this head, base, changed-file
# set and pull request. It also prints which path-filtered workflows apply to
# the changed paths and what each concluded on this head. The admission-gate
# jobs of the heavy workflows read this run's result instead of calling Clued.
#
# `pull_request_target` (step 7 review, BLOCKER 95a93218): this file and
# scripts/ci/clued-work-admission.mjs are taken from the base branch, and no
# code of the PR is checked out or executed, so a PR cannot change how its own
# admission is judged. The PR is read through the API only. `edited` re-runs
# the check when the PR body (and so the trailer) changes; the hourly
# clued-work-admission-reverify.yml re-runs a passing check whose claim no
# longer admits the PR.
#
# Re-review 3, N-R4: a re-run replays the run's own copy of this file. The
# token and the App key were renamed (CLUED_ADMISSION_CLUED_TOKEN,
# CLUED_ADMISSION_APP_KEY) and the old names retired, so a re-run of a run from
# before this change gets neither and posts nothing.
#
# The token lives in the `clued-admission` environment (Owner setting:
# deployment branches limited to main, no reviewers). A pull_request_target
# run and the scheduled re-verification run on main, so they get it; a
# workflow a PR adds or edits runs on refs/pull/N/merge and does not, even if
# it names the environment. No `pull_request` trigger here: every PR, one that
# edits this file included, is judged by the base-branch copy.
#
# Not covered here: a PR can add another workflow whose job is also named
# kooyumi-work-admission; both are GitHub Actions check runs. Closing that needs
# a check identity a PR workflow cannot use (a GitHub App, or required
# workflows), which is an Owner setting outside the repository.
#
# The check is always enforced (Merge Admission step 6 retired the advisory
# switch CLUED_WORK_ADMISSION_ENFORCE): a missing claim, a REJECTED verdict, a
# missing RPC, a refused token or a transport error all fail closed. Hosted runner on purpose: seconds of
# work, no application dependency install, no self-hosted capacity.

on:
  pull_request_target:
    # Merge Admission v0.1 §4.2 (step 2): turning auto-merge on or off
    # re-judges the pull request, so frozen's "auto-merge forbidden" holds at once.
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, edited, ready_for_review, closed, auto_merge_enabled, auto_merge_disabled]

permissions:
  actions: read
  checks: read
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read

# The merge report (clued-work-adopt) runs in its own group, so a later edit
# of the merged pull request cannot cancel it (re-review N7).
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}-${{ github.event.action == 'closed' && 'closed' || 'open' }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event.action != 'closed' }}

jobs:
  clued-work-admission:
    name: kooyumi-work-admission
    # Re-review 6, B1: pull_request_target runs the default branch's workflow
    # with the default branch's ref whatever the pull request's base, so this
    # environment's secrets would reach a pull request into any branch. Only
    # pull requests into the default branch are admitted here; the gates and
    # the runner check refuse the others (no admission check).
    if: >-
      github.event.action != 'closed' &&
      github.event.pull_request.state == 'open' &&
      github.event.pull_request.base.ref == github.event.repository.default_branch
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    timeout-minutes: 5
    environment: clued-admission
    steps:
      # The default branch as it is now, never the PR head or merge ref, and
      # never another base branch, whose script an Agent could have edited.
      # Re-review 3, N-R4: not the event's base commit, which a re-run of an
      # old run would replay together with that commit's older checks.
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: "22"
      - name: Configure job temporary storage
        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage
      - name: Self-test the admission script (no network, mocked fetch)
        run: |
          node --version
          node --test scripts/ci/clued-work-admission.test.mjs scripts/ci/merge-admission-policy.test.mjs scripts/ci/clued-release-grant.test.mjs scripts/runner/clued-runner-job-started.test.mjs
      - name: Verify the work claim with Clued and summarize applicable workflows
        id: admit
        env:
          CLUED_CONTEXT_READ_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLUED_ADMISSION_CLUED_TOKEN }}
          # Merge Admission v0.1 §4: the Owner's global state (normal when
          # unset, efficiency, frozen; any other value is frozen). The rules
          # come from config/merge-admission-policy.json of this checkout.
          CLUED_MERGE_ADMISSION_STATE: ${{ vars.CLUED_MERGE_ADMISSION_STATE }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: node scripts/ci/clued-work-admission.mjs --mode required
      # Owner Decision 37e01bb1: the same result once more as the Owner's
      # clued-admission GitHub App. Its key lives only in this environment, so
      # a pull request's own workflow cannot post this check and the main
      # ruleset can require it by App. Posts nothing until the App is set up.
      - name: Post the result as the clued-admission App
        # Merge Admission step 2: a pull request found closed is not judged and gets no
        # check (the admission step still fails, so the run is not a success).
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.admit.outputs.verdict != 'PR_NOT_OPEN' }}
        env:
          # Re-review 3, N-R6: when the admission step fails before it names
          # the head, the failure is still posted on the event's head, so an
          # older success does not stay the newest check.
          ADMISSION_HEAD_SHA: ${{ steps.admit.outputs.head_sha || github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          # Re-review 4, m1/m2: the check names its pull request, so the gate
          # accepts only its own pull request's admission.
          ADMISSION_PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          ADMISSION_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.admit.outcome }}
          ADMISSION_VERDICT: ${{ steps.admit.outputs.verdict }}
          # Merge Admission v0.1 §10: the mode the head was judged in, shown
          # in the check's title ("ADMITTED [normal · code · reruns 0]").
          ADMISSION_MODE: ${{ steps.admit.outputs.admission_mode }}
          # Owner Decision 2ea795e4: the kooyumi-merge-slot check on the same
          # head. A head that contains the base branch's tip passes it only
          # while its claim holds the merge slot; an empty state fails it.
          ADMISSION_MERGE_SLOT: ${{ steps.admit.outputs.merge_slot }}
          ADMISSION_MERGE_SLOT_REF: ${{ steps.admit.outputs.merge_slot_ref }}
          ADMISSION_MERGE_SLOT_UNTIL: ${{ steps.admit.outputs.merge_slot_until }}
          ADMISSION_MERGE_SLOT_TIP: ${{ steps.admit.outputs.merge_slot_tip }}
          ADMISSION_CLAIM_ID: ${{ steps.admit.outputs.claim_id }}
          ADMISSION_BASE_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.ref }}
          CLUED_CONTEXT_READ_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLUED_ADMISSION_CLUED_TOKEN }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          CLUED_ADMISSION_APP_ID: ${{ secrets.CLUED_ADMISSION_APP_ID }}
          CLUED_ADMISSION_APP_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.CLUED_ADMISSION_APP_KEY }}
        run: node scripts/ci/clued-work-admission.mjs --mode app-check

      - name: Export the closed local natural R9 packet
        if: ${{ always() }}
        run: node scripts/ci/merge-admission-source-producer.mjs --export admission
      - name: Preserve natural R9 source observations
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: clued-r9-natural-source-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}-${{ github.job }}
          path: .clued-r9-source-events/sealed/${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}-${{ github.job }}/natural-packet.json
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 90

  # GenericWorkClaim §5.3, multi-copy write-back: a merged pull request is
  # reported to Clued once (clued_work_claim_adopt_v1). When its Task runs as
  # a race, the copy bound to this pull request is adopted and the other
  # copies are put out; their pull requests fail the next verification. A

#      default branch within 30 minutes and names that workflow and ref.

# deployment branches are limited to main; the job also refuses any other ref.
# Default-branch code only, hosted runner, no application dependency install.

  workflow_dispatch:

      workflow:
        description: Heavy workflow that will be dispatched

        options:

          - clued-g4-database.yml

name: clued-merge-slot-ci

# Merge Admission v0.1 §7.3, step 3 of §13 (Task 3576d10d; Owner Decisions
# 4f576896 and 1fb7f6b3): the merge slot follows CI. Each time a CI workflow
# run of a pull request completes, and by hand, this reports to Clued the CI
# state of each open pull request that holds a merge slot
# (scripts/ci/clued-merge-slot-ci.mjs, clued_work_merge_slot_touch_v1):
# running keeps the slot 90 minutes, green 30 minutes, failed returns it and
# fails the head's kooyumi-merge-slot check. The hourly report is a step of
# clued-work-admission-reverify.yml, which runs anyway, so it costs no extra
# hosted run. The holder no longer renews its claim to keep the slot.

# report. No second workflow is started; skipped or failed reports cannot
# execute it. The executor still reads the queue and exact-head authorization
# itself. Ten minutes preserves the two former five-minute job budgets.

# workflow_run runs this file and the script from the default branch, with
# the clued-admission environment's token and App key (deployment branches
# limited to main). The triggering event is only a signal: the script reads
# the pull requests, check runs and workflow runs itself and trusts nothing in
# the event. The job's condition uses the event only to skip runs of push and
# schedule events, which are never a pull request's head. A pull request
# cannot change this file for its own run.

      - contract-placement
      - Clued connection authorization candidate
      - Clued G4 Database Gate
      - design-refs

      - Clued handover hook qualification / company-linux-02
      - Clued handover hook qualification / company-linux-03
      - Clued handover hook qualification / company-linux-04
